summary: Iteration 126 full-regression across Control Intelligence — focus on the two newest features (Recap History + Timeline PDF Export) plus surrounding auditor/recap/timeline/analytics/nudge work. Reviewer engagement analytics tiles ci-analytics-views/downloads/reviewers present; ci-auditor-analytics panel OK. Mission Control demo toggle (control-intel-demo-toggle) OK. All 6 CI tabs (Mission Control, Control Effectiveness, Framework Intelligence, Evidence Assurance, Remediation & Drift, Defensibility) load without console errors. Executive Overview badge exec-assurance-activity present in header reading 'ASSURANCE 30d · 6 views · 1 downloads · 1 reviewer' (live from /auditor-link/activity). Cleanup executed at end: revoke minted link (200), unmute nudge (200), reset settings (200).

issues: data-testid=auth-submit click is intercepted by a decorative overlay/animation in some viewports; Enter-key from password field submits reliably. Non-blocking but tests should prefer Enter.

critical_code_review_comments: auditor_recap_history (control_intelligence.py L1149) correctly projects out _id/org_id and sorts by at desc — clean list contract for the frontend.
_log_recap wraps insert in try/except (fail-safe) — a failed log won't break the /recap/send response.
auditor_timeline_pdf (L1157) uses _resolve_brand(org) and streams via StreamingResponse — proper media_type and cover page.
Analytics endpoint shape is {links,reviewers,totals} — good for frontend, but two aliases might reduce confusion vs activity endpoint {views,downloads,reviewers} flat.

control_intelligence.py is ~1182 lines — nearing the 700-line split threshold. Recap/Timeline/Brief/Analytics/Auditor-link/Nudge modules could each live in submodules. FORK-HAZARD noted by main agent aligns with this size.
ci-auditor-link-reissue/revoke and ci-muted-owners render conditionally — consider rendering the container with an empty-state to give tests a stable anchor (minor UX/test polish, not a bug).
